 Paola Garcia backs Corinthians but warns of stern Santa Fe test 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article The CONMEBOL Libertadores Feminina group stage ends on Wednesday, with already-qualified Corinthians facing Colombian side Santa Fe at 17:00 Brasília time for control of Group A.
 "I believe a lot in the team, we have worked very hard to reach this stage. We always want to give our best, and the best is to stay top after the next game. I cannot say Santa Fe are an easy team, nobody is in the Libertadores by chance," said Colombian midfielder Paola Garcia . She was speaking to Corinthians TV.
 OneFootball Videos
 Garcia was a standout in the rout of Caracas, scoring one of the seven goals that sealed early qualification. It was her first official goal for Corinthians and her return to action after almost two months without featuring under coach Emily Lima.
 Corinthians and Santa Fe are level on six points, with Corinthians ahead on goal difference, nine compared with two. The outcome could also shape a potential quarter-final derby.
 In Group B, Palmeiras lead with six points and face Ecuador’s Independiente del Valle at 21:00, who have four. If standings hold, Corinthians would meet the Ecuadorians in the last eight and Palmeiras would face Santa Fe, but a change in either group leader would bring a derby in the first knockout round.
 To avoid that early meeting, Palmeiras need a win and Corinthians must maintain their dominant record over Santa Fe. The sides have met four times, including two finals, with Corinthians victorious in all, most recently 2-0 in the 2024 final and 1-0 in the 2025 group stage.
